content_json.efficacy: 철 결핍성 빈혈의 예방 및 치료에 사용하는 일반의약품입니다.
content_json.usage:
성인 및 12세 이상은 1일 1회, 1캡슐을 식후 복용합니다.
정해진 용법·용량을 지키세요.
content_json.caution:
경고: 만 6세 이하의 어린이가 과량 복용시 철분 중독성 사망을 일으킬 수 있으므로 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하세요.

다음 분은 복용하지 마세요. 이 약에 과민증 환자, 12개월 미만의 영아, 혈색소증, 헤모시데린침착증, 철 이용 장애, 비철결핍성 빈혈, 철과잉증, 감염이나 종양으로 인한 철결핍성빈혈, 만성췌장염, 간경변 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마세요.

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요. 이 약을 복용하기 전에 소화성궤양, 만성궤양성대장염, 국한성대장염 등의 위장질환, 심장ㆍ순환기계기능 장애, 발작성야 혈색소뇨증, 신장애, 저단백혈증, 폴산이 부족한 환자는 약사와 상의하세요.

정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키세요.

12세 이상 청소년에게 투여할 경우 보호자의 지도 감독하에 투여하세요.

인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 항생제, 제산제와 함께 복용하지 마세요.이 약을 복용하기 전에 철 함유제제(철분제, MRI용 간장 조영제 등), 항알도스테론제, 트리암테렌, 퀴놀론계, 페니실라민, 콜레스티라민, 췌장엑스 및 비타민 E와 같은 물질, 디포스폰산 염류, 티록신, 세프디니르 제제, 200 mg 이상의 아스코르빈산(비타민 C)을 함께 복용 시 약사와 상의하세요.녹차, 홍차 등 탄닌을 함유하는 차 및 우유ㆍ유제품은 복용 중, 복용 전후에는 피하세요.

두드러기, 가려움, 햇빛 노출시 피부 과민반응, 복부ㆍ위통증, 위 경련, 위부불쾌감, 구토, 설사, 구역, 식욕부진, 변비, 흑변, 치아변색, 열, 혼수, 진단 또는 검사 시 AST, ALT의 상승, ALP 상승 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.
content_json.ingredientSelection:
제품에 따라 성분 구성과 함량이 다를 수 있으니, 지병이나 복용 중인 약이 있으면 매장의 약사에게 확인하세요.
증상이 지속되거나 궁금한 점이 있으면 매장 내 약사 등 전문가와 상담하세요.

en.title: Hemoten Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine for the prevention and treatment of iron-deficiency anemia.
en.usage: Adults and children aged 12 or older take 1 capsule once a day after a meal. Keep to the stated dose.
en.caution: Warning: an overdose in children aged 6 or under can cause fatal iron poisoning, so keep this medicine out of the reach of children. Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are an infant under 12 months, or have hemochromatosis, hemosiderosis, an iron-utilization disorder, non-iron-deficiency anemia, iron overload, iron-deficiency anemia caused by infection or tumor, chronic pancreatitis, or liver cirrhosis. Consult a pharmacist before use if you have a gastrointestinal disease such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis or regional colitis, or have heart or circulatory disorders, paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, kidney impairment, low blood protein, or folic acid deficiency. Keep to the stated dose and directions. For adolescents aged 12 or older, use under the supervision of a guardian. Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist before taking it with iron-containing preparations (iron supplements, MRI liver contrast agents), anti-aldosterone agents, triamterene, quinolones, penicillamine, cholestyramine, pancreatic extract and substances such as vitamin E, diphosphonates, thyroxine, cefdinir preparations, or 200 mg or more of ascorbic acid (vitamin C). Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea, and milk and dairy products, while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it. Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if you notice hives, itching, skin reactions on sun exposure, abdominal or stomach pain, stomach cramps, stomach discomfort, vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, loss of appetite, constipation, black stools, tooth discoloration, fever, coma, or raised AST, ALT or ALP on diagnosis or testing.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Prevention and treatment of iron-deficiency anemia

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요. 이 약을 복용하기 전에 신장애, 신체 허약자, 인 함량이 낮은 식이요법 실시자, 소화흡수장애가 있는 사람, 고령자, 혈액구토 또는 흑색대변 등과 같은 소화기관출혈 증상이 있는 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및 수유부는 의사 또는 약사와 상담하세요. 2주정도 복용하여도 증상의 개선이 없을 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.

정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키세요.

어린이에게 투여할 경우 보호자의 지도 감독하에 투여하세요.

이 약을 복용하는 동안 테트라사이클린계 항생제는 복용하지 마세요.이 약을 복용하기 전에 비스테로이드소염(항염)진통제, 궤양치료제, 디기탈리스 제제, 클로르프로마진, 란소프라졸, 프레드니솔론, 페니실린, 퀴놀론, 철(Fe)염 제제, 살리실산염을 복용하는 환자는 약사와 상의하세요.

변비, 설사 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.

en.title: Aprogen Almagate Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for antacid action and symptom improvement in gastric and duodenal ulcer, gastritis, excess stomach acid, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and sour burping.
en.usage: Adults and children aged 12 or older chew 2 tablets (1 g) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes to 1 hour after meals. If needed, one more dose may be taken before bedtime. Keep to the stated dose.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or have Alzheimer's disease, hemorrhoids, fluid retention (swelling), toxemia of pregnancy, diarrhea, or undiagnosed gastrointestinal bleeding. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have kidney impairment, are physically weak, are on a low-phosphorus diet, have digestive-absorption disorders, are elderly, have symptoms of gastrointestinal bleeding such as vomiting blood or black stools, or are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. If symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist. Keep to the stated dose and directions. For children, use under the supervision of a guardian. Do not take tetracycline antibiotics while taking this medicine. Consult a pharmacist before use if you take nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, ulcer medicines, digitalis preparations, chlorpromazine, lansoprazole, prednisolone, penicillin, quinolones, iron (Fe) salt preparations, or salicylates. Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if constipation or diarrhea occurs.

en.title: Neocalcu Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine for supplying vitamins D and B1 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered strength during and after illness, the growth period and old age, and for poor development of bones and teeth and the prevention of rickets.
en.usage: Adults take 1 tablet once a day. Keep to the stated dose.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if you have hypercalcemia (excess calcium in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause), kidney disease, are hypersensitive to it, are an infant under 12 months, or have kidney stones or severe kidney failure. Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, for premature babies and infants, or if you have heart or circulatory disorders, kidney impairment, low blood protein, are taking cardiac glycosides, or have had kidney stones. If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist. Keep to the stated dose and directions. Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist before taking it with anti-aldosterone agents or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it. Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loose stools, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, or skin rash occurs.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Vitamin D and B1 supply during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered strength during and after illness, the growth period and old age, and bone and tooth development

en.title: Ganetop Gold Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine for the supportive treatment of chronic liver disease, liver cirrhosis, and toxic liver disease.
en.usage: Adults take 1 capsule 3 times a day. Keep to the stated dose.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are hypersensitive to soybean oil, soy or peanuts, have severe biliary obstruction, or are a child aged 12 or under. Consult a pharmacist before use if you have a fat-metabolism disorder such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia or pancreatitis, are a patient at particular risk from fat overload, are pregnant or may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. Keep to the stated dose and directions. Do not take it together with levodopa. Consult a pharmacist before use with intravenous lipid preparations.

en.usage: Children aged 12 or older and adults take 1 to 2 tablets once a day after a meal. Keep to the stated dose.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are an infant under 12 months, or have hypercalcemia (excess calcium in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause), kidney disease, kidney stones, or severe kidney failure. Consult a pharmacist before use for children who get plenty of sunlight and eat normal meals, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant or breastfeeding, for premature babies and infants, or if you have hyperoxaluria (excess oxalate in the urine), heart or circulatory disorders, low blood protein, gout or kidney stones, a tendency to blood clots, folic acid deficiency, or hypersensitivity or past reactions to Yellow No. 5. If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist. Keep to the stated dose and directions. For children, use under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in urine tests and may turn the urine yellow, affecting laboratory test values. Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist before taking it with cardiac glycosides, oral contraceptives containing estrogen, anti-aldosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it. en.title: Tansina Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine for excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort, stomach bloating, food stagnation, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and sour burping.
en.usage: People aged 15 or older and adults take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times a day. Leave at least 4 hours between doses. Keep to the stated dose.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if you are a child aged 7 or under. Consult a pharmacist before use if you have kidney impairment, are on a sodium-restricted diet, or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or have had reactions to it. Keep to the stated dose and directions. Stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist if constipation or diarrhea occurs.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort, bloating, food stagnation, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and sour burping
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort, stomach bloating, food stagnation, nausea
